The assignment

Create a spaceship using only primitives, no polygons.

Reference

From plans to model

Built from construction plans

The ship was modeled from a set of construction plans, using only Cinema 4D's primitive shapes (cubes, cylinders, discs and tubes) instead of editing polygons by hand.

Construction plans from the cygnus-x1.net reference library. Shown for non-commercial, educational study only. All rights belong to their creators.
The ship's design is based on the USS Enterprise (NCC-1701) from Star Trek, a trademark of Paramount. This is a student fan study and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Paramount.
